notes: Each task compares the same declared samples under the same adaptive policy and shared configuration.
All-sample latency includes timeouts and incorrect results; it is not a claim of useful speedup.
Both-correct latency conditions on success in both arms; its count is reported and it is not the full-task accuracy metric.
Finite wall includes cold graph capture. Phase timers are unfenced host intervals, not isolated GPU timings.
Only complete evaluated pairs receive a comparison; pending and infrastructure-failed attempts are not imputed as model scores.
Allocator retry arms share the same explicit allocator setting and retain their separate run identity.
